comment.text: FANK1 Q4 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v1. Source observations include Adrenocortical carcinoma; Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: gbc; Hepatocellular carcinoma. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position. This site is present only in the historical V1 material in this collection.

applicability_notes: Confirm the exact allele and reference transcript: source protein numbering is not a validated clinical HGVS assertion.

An observed synonymous or stop allele is retained for source fidelity and is not automatically classified as oncogenic.

report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting FANK1 residue Q4 have been observed in adrenocortical carcinoma and hepatocellular carcinoma. The functional and clinical significance depend on the specific alteration and tumor type.

comment.text: FANK1 Q4* is an allele annotation observed in Cancer Hotspots v1 at the Q4 hotspot or indel region. This documents recurrence in the source cohorts; allele-specific function, tumor-specific significance, reference-sequence mapping, and clinical actionability require independent review.

report_comment.text: The FANK1 Q4* alteration has been observed in adrenocortical carcinoma and hepatocellular carcinoma. Its functional and clinical significance require allele- and tumor-specific assessment.
